summary: Order placement 500s are caused by the order-service deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0, rolled out 12:10:08Z), which added MarginCheckValidator and removed the legacy margin validation. The new validator dereferences a null marginProfile for F&O orders, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500. Onset is exact: error_rate rises from ~0.2% to ~18.5% at the 12:12 bucket, first NPE logged at 12:12:31Z, and FNO-specific messages match the reported 'mostly derivatives orders' symptom. Downstream dependencies (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway) and order-service resources (CPU/memory/pool/latency/request rate/restarts) are all flat, ruling out dependency, capacity, resource and config causes. Recommended action: roll back dep-5101 to the prior version.

ranked_hypotheses.title: New MarginCheckValidator null-dereferences marginProfile for FNO orders (bad deployment dep-5101)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101, 12:10Z) added MarginCheckValidator and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(). The new validator dereferences a null marginProfile for F&O orders, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500. Because FNO orders are ~18% of order flow, aggregate error rate rose to ~18%.

causal_chain.claim: Deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0) introduces new MarginCheckValidator into validation chain at 12:10Z
Null marginProfile causes NPE -> order rejected with 500
Aggregate error_rate jumps to ~18% from 12:12Z onward
api-gateway error rate rises only as a pass-through of order-service failures

assumptions: marginProfile being null is the actual defect condition (vs. a data issue where margin profiles are genuinely missing)
the 18% error rate corresponds to the FNO share of order traffic rather than a separate issue

ranked_hypotheses.title: Data issue: missing margin profiles for F&O accounts
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A subset of F&O accounts lack a marginProfile record, so any margin validation fails (and the new validator does not handle it). The fault would originate in the data/datastore rather than the code. Weakened by the fact that the same validator class is new as of 12:10 and no errors existed before, so absence of data alone would not explain onset.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: No errors existed before 12:10 despite the same accounts/flow; onset aligns exactly with the code deploy, and downstream data services showed no anomaly. The new code path is the proximate cause.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Dependency failure (pricing-engine / exchange-gateway / market-data)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A downstream dependency degraded causing order rejections.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: pricing-engine and exchange-gateway error rates stayed ~0.2% throughout; error messages are local NPEs in order-service validation, not downstream timeouts.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion / capacity saturation in order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU, memory, DB pool or connection saturation caused 500s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cpu ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14, restarts 0, request_rate flat ~233 req/s; latency flat. No resource pressure and no load spike.

facts.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101) added MarginCheckValidator and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(), rolling out at 12:10:08Z.
order-service error_rate rose from ~0.2% to 18.49% at the 12:12 bucket and stayed ~18%.
First errors are NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate:88 for orderType=FNO at 12:12:31Z.
Errors are dominated by NPE in MarginCheckValidator and 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null'.
Downstream pricing-engine and exchange-gateway error rates stayed ~0.2%.
api-gateway error rate rose to ~3.4% from 12:10, reflecting order-service failures.
order-service cpu/memory/pool/restarts metrics are flat with no resource pressure.
order-service request_rate was flat ~233 req/s (no traffic surge).
No config changes touched order-service; only an unrelated notification-service batch-size change.
No WARN/ERROR entries in order-service before the deploy window.

timeline.event: Error rate still ~18.4%; no recovery, no rollback

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service dep-5101 to the previous version (pre-v2.14.0) immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: The failure onset coincides exactly with this deploy; removing the new MarginCheckValidator restores the working legacy margin validation path.

recommended_actions.action: Confirm recovery by watching order-service error_rate return to ~0.2% and absence of MarginCheckValidator NPEs after rollback.
recommended_actions.rationale: Error rate has stayed ~18% with no self-recovery; verify the rollback actually clears the symptom.

recommended_actions.action: Add null-handling/guard for marginProfile in MarginCheckValidator and unit tests for F&O orders with missing margin profiles.
recommended_actions.rationale: Root defect is a null-dereference on the new F&O margin-check path.

recommended_actions.action: Verify whether marginProfile is legitimately absent for some F&O accounts and fix the data path if so.
recommended_actions.rationale: Distinguish a purely defensive-coding bug from genuinely missing margin data.

data_gaps: order-service ERROR log query was truncated (returned 30 of 427 matches), so the full error distribution and any additional error patterns beyond the two NPE forms are not fully enumerated.
query_logs for order-service timed out on two attempts (tc-001, tc-006), so INFO/DEBUG context around the deploy is only partially available.
market-data-service error_rate query timed out (tc-016); its health was not directly verified (though pricing-engine, its caller, was normal).
exchange-api is external with has_telemetry=false, so its health is inferred only from exchange-gateway's normal upstream_error_rate, not directly measured.

findings.statement: order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) completed rollout at 12:10:08Z; its change summary is 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders' with 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'.

findings.statement: order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% (buckets through 12:05) to 18.49% at the 12:12 bucket and stayed ~18% through end of window.
The first order-service errors after the deploy are NullPointerExceptions at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) for orderType=FNO, first seen 12:12:31Z.

Errors are the dominant pattern in order-service logs (426 ERROR of 427 matches, truncated) and are overwhelmingly of two forms: NPE in MarginCheckValidator (224) and 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>' (202), both FNO-scoped.

findings.statement: Downstream services are normal: pricing-engine error_rate stayed ~0.2% (max 0.32) across the whole window, and exchange-gateway error_rate stayed ~0.2% (max 0.32).
api-gateway error_rate rose from ~0.2% to ~3.4% starting at the 12:10 bucket, i.e. it reflects the subset of traffic hitting order-service.
order-service resource metrics are flat through the incident: cpu_pct ~40%, memory_pct ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14, restarts 0.
order-service request_rate is flat at ~233 req/s across the window (min 210, max 256), so there was no traffic surge.
The only config change in the window is cfg-2101 on notification-service (email.batch_size 200->250) at 11:21Z; no config change on order-service or its dependencies.
There were zero WARN/ERROR log entries in order-service before the deploy window 11:30-12:12Z (prior WARN query returned 0 matches over 08:00-13:59).
order-service latency_p99_ms is flat ~150ms throughout, so the failures are fast rejections, not slow/timeout failures.
